description: This file defines a Kivy UI widget called Spinner, including its class, properties, and methods for dropdown behavior, option handling, and user interaction.

classes.name: SpinnerOption
classes.description: A specialized button used within the Spinner dropdown list, inheriting from Button.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A widget that allows users to select a value from a dropdown list, with properties for customization and methods for dropdown management.

methods.name: _build_dropdown
methods.description: Constructs or rebuilds the dropdown menu widget, resolving class if specified as a string.

methods.name: _update_dropdown_size
methods.description: Updates the height of dropdown items to match the Spinner's height if sync_height is enabled.

methods.name: _update_dropdown
methods.description: Populates the dropdown with options based on the values property, creating option instances and binding selection events.

methods.name: _toggle_dropdown
methods.description: Toggles the dropdown open or closed based on current state.

methods.name: _on_dropdown_select
methods.description: Handles selection of an item from the dropdown, updating the Spinner's text and closing the dropdown.

methods.name: on_is_open
methods.description: Event handler to open or dismiss the dropdown when is_open property changes.
